subject.title: docs(gateway): add launchd supervisor loop troubleshooting

question: Should OpenClaw publish this docs-first launchd recovery runbook, including the node LaunchAgent disable step for gateway-only hosts, before runtime wrapper and doctor/install hardening land?
rationale: The patch is docs-only and source-backed, but the documented operator action can stop node-service behavior on some macOS hosts, so automation should not decide that product/support tradeoff.

options.title: Accept Docs-First Mitigation
options.body: Land this runbook as immediate recovery guidance while leaving runtime wrapper generation and doctor/install hardening in the linked issue.

options.title: Pause For Runtime Policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide the durable launchd marker, node-service lifecycle, and doctor repair policy.

options.title: Narrow The Runbook
options.body: Merge only the detection and wrapper-order guidance now, and defer public node LaunchAgent disable instructions to the runtime issue.

recommendation.title: Accept Docs-First Mitigation
recommendation.body: Land this runbook as immediate recovery guidance while leaving runtime wrapper generation and doctor/install hardening in the linked issue.
